movelist.name: Double Team
movelist.effect: The user gains 3 activations of Double Team. The user may either activate Double Team when being targeted by an attack to increase their Evasion by +2 against that attack; or when making an attack to increase their Accuracy by +2 for that attack.

movelist.name: Astonish
movelist.effect: Astonish Flinches the target on 15+. Once per scene, if the target is unaware of the user’s presence, Astonish automatically Flinches the target.

movelist.name: Copycat
movelist.effect: Use the Move the target has used on their last turn. You may choose new targets for the Move. Copycat cannot miss.

movelist.name: Splash
movelist.effect: Shift Action - The user may make a single Jump, adding +1 to their Long Jump and High Jump values, and gains +2 Evasion until the end of their next turn.

movelist.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
movelist.effect: The target’s Attack is lowered 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Disguise
abilities.effect: The triggering attack instead misses and has no effect. The user then gains +1 CS in a Stat of their choice. Defensive.

abilities.name: Technician
abilities.effect: Moves with a Damage Base of 6 or lower have their Damage Base increased by +2. This bonus always applies to Moves with the Double Strike or Fivestrike Keywords.
